themes.note: Frontmatter colours are the Light theme. 'System' follows prefers-color-scheme between Light and Dark. --primary/--accent = var(--ink) and --on-primary/--on-accent = var(--bg) in every theme and mode. Omitted --red inherits Light.

display.purpose: Focus counter / timer inside the display well; right-aligned, tabular.

readout.purpose: Value in each Home display well; wide wells use clamp(44px, 13vw, 72px).

headline.purpose: One page title per screen, Golos Text.

label.purpose: Uppercase mono labels naming a field or reading.

key-legend.purpose: Uppercase mono text printed on tabs, segmented strips, text keys.

shadows.name: key-raised
shadows.purpose: Every key at rest; selected chip, active segment, mode thumb.

shadows.name: key-pressed
shadows.purpose: Active, latched and current-tab keys, paired with translateY(1px).

shadows.name: led-halo
shadows.purpose: Lit LED dots (power LED in ink; selected chip LED uses its marker colour).

motion.name: ease-instrument
motion.purpose: Key press, mode thumb, sheet entry, screen settle.

motion.name: boot-sequence
motion.purpose: Power-on self-test every launch; digits settle 70ms apart, wells stagger 90ms; skipped under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Key
components.description: The single ink-inverted primary key per view; full width in sheets.
components.css: .ds-key { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; height: 50px; padding: 0 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--key, #f7f7f5); color: var(--key-ink, #161616); font-family: 'Golos Text', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 16px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 85%), 0 1px 0 var(--key-edge, #bababa), 0 2px 3px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 22%); transition: transform 90ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow 90ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-key-primary { width: 100%; background: var(--primary, #161616); color: var(--on-primary, #e9e9e7); } .ds-key:hover { filter: brightness(1.04); } .ds-key:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #161616); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-key:active { transform: translateY(1px); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 18%); }

components.name: Secondary Key
components.description: Key-face button for secondary actions; danger variant swaps legend to red.
components.css: .ds-key2 { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; height: 50px; padding: 0 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--key, #f7f7f5); color: var(--key-ink, #161616); font-family: 'Golos Text', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 16px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 85%), 0 1px 0 var(--key-edge, #bababa), 0 2px 3px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 22%); transition: transform 90ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-key2:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--key, #f7f7f5) 90%, var(--ink, #161616)); } .ds-key2:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #161616); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-key2:active { transform: translateY(1px); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 18%); } .ds-key2-danger { color: var(--red, #d33a3f); }

components.name: Display Well
components.description: Recessed LCD window: legend row, ghost-8 readout, segment meter.
components.html:
TASKSPLAN 4:30/8:00

components.css: .ds-well { width: 280px; min-height: 136px; padding: 14px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--well, #d5d5d2); color: var(--well-ink, #121212); box-shadow: inset 0 2px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / 22%), inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(0 0 0 / 22%), 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 85%); } .ds-legend { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--well-dim, #4d4d4a); } .ds-read { position: relative; margin-top: auto; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 56px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -.04em; line-height: .95; } .ds-ghost { color: rgb(0 0 0 / 7%); } .ds-live { position: absolute; inset: 0; } .ds-segs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(10, 1fr); gap: 3px; height: 10px; } .ds-segs i { border-radius: 1.5px; background: rgb(0 0 0 / 7%); } .ds-segs i.on { background: var(--well-ink, #121212); }

components.name: Field
components.description: Input as a small display well with a silk-screen legend.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; width: 280px; } .ds-field span { display: block; margin: 0 0 8px 2px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: .12em; color: var(--muted, #5a5a57); } .ds-field input { width: 100%; height: 48px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--well, #d5d5d2); color: var(--well-ink, #121212); caret-color: var(--primary, #161616); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 500; box-shadow: inset 0 2px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / 22%), inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(0 0 0 / 22%); } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: var(--well-dim, #4d4d4a); opacity: .8; } .ds-field input:focus { outline: none; box-shadow: inset 0 2px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / 22%), inset 0 0 0 2px var(--primary, #161616); }

components.name: LED Chip
components.description: Small key with a square LED in the item colour; selected = raised key, lit LED.
components.css: .ds-chip { --c: var(--muted, #5a5a57); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #161616); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line, #d0d0cd); font-family: 'Golos Text', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-chip::before { content: ''; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--c); opacity: .55; } .ds-chip small { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; color: var(--muted, #5a5a57); font-size: 12px; } .ds-chip:hover { background: var(--soft, #dededb); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #161616); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--key, #f7f7f5); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 85%), 0 1px 0 var(--key-edge, #bababa), 0 2px 3px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 20%); } .ds-chip[aria-pressed='true']::before { opacity: 1; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--c) 22%, transparent); }

components.name: Key-row Tab Bar
components.description: Phone navigation: four keys; current key pressed in with an ink LED.
components.html: HomeTasksCalendarFocus
components.css: .ds-tabbar { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 6px; padding: 8px 12px; width: 360px; background: var(--soft, #dededb); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 var(--line, #d0d0cd); } .ds-tab { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 3px; height: 56px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--key, #f7f7f5); color: var(--muted, #5a5a57); cursor: pointer; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 85%), 0 1px 0 var(--key-edge, #bababa), 0 2px 3px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 18%); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: transform 90ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), color 150ms ease; } .ds-tab svg { width: 21px; height: 21px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--ink, #161616); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #161616); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-tab:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-tab[aria-current='page'] { color: var(--ink, #161616); transform: translateY(1px); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / 18%); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--key, #f7f7f5) 80%, var(--soft, #dededb)); } .ds-tab[aria-current='page']::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 7px; right: 9px; width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--primary, #161616); }

components.name: FAB Key
components.description: Phone primary action: 60px ink-faced key with a hard 2px drop.
components.css: .ds-fab { width: 60px; height: 60px; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; display: grid; place-items: center; cursor: pointer; background: var(--primary, #161616); color: var(--on-primary, #e9e9e7); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 35%), 0 2px 0 var(--key-edge, #bababa), 0 10px 22px -8px rgb(0 0 0 / 45%); transition: transform 90ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow 90ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-fab svg { width: 26px; height: 26px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2.4; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-fab:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); } .ds-fab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #161616); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-fab:active { transform: translateY(2px); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 25%), 0 0 0 transparent; }

components.name: Mode Switch
components.description: Recessed two-way strip with a sliding raised thumb and an ink LED.
components.css: .ds-modes { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; width: 320px; padding: 4px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--soft, #dededb); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 10%); } .ds-thumb { position: absolute; top: 4px; bottom: 4px; left: 4px; width: calc(50% - 4px); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--key, #f7f7f5); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 85%), 0 1px 0 var(--key-edge, #bababa), 0 2px 3px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 20%); transform: translateX(calc(100% * var(--i))); transition: transform 260ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-modes button { position: relative; height: 40px; border: 0; background: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted, #5a5a57); transition: color 200ms ease; } .ds-modes button:hover { color: var(--ink, #161616); } .ds-modes button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #161616); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-modes button[aria-selected='true'] { color: var(--ink, #161616); } .ds-modes button[aria-selected='true']::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 8px; right: 10px; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--primary, #161616); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary, #161616) 25%, transparent); }

narrative.overview:
Okto is an engineering calculator in the Braun ET66 / HP-15C lineage, used as a planner and rendered in black and white. The page background is the instrument's casing. Every metric lives in a recessed display well, set in tabular JetBrains Mono with unlit "8" segments behind the live digits. Every control is a key: a rounded rectangle with a hairline top highlight and a 1px drop that sinks 1px when pressed. Prose (greetings, task titles, sheet headings) is set in Golos Text, so the instrument stays readable and never turns into a terminal costume.

It is built for Operate mode: many short visits a day, one-handed on a phone. Density is moderate and the shell never moves. There is no brand hue. The primary action is the ink colour inverted onto a key (a black key in light themes, a white key in dark themes), and state is shown with ink LED dots. Red is the only signal colour and means alarm. The only other colours are the user's own: list and counter colours on small markers and calendar events. Motion follows the instrument's own behaviour: the power-on self-test at launch, the key press, and the display tick. It is not decorative.

The system rejects the soft-card productivity app, hacker neon / terminal styling, and (by the owner's decision) a yellow/ochre brand accent. Depth comes from physical metaphor (raised keys, sunken wells), not from floating cards.
keyCharacteristics: Casing ground, raised keys, recessed display wells: three material layers, each with its own tokens.
JetBrains Mono for every numeral and every silk-screen legend; Golos Text for every sentence.
Monochrome: the primary key is the ink inverted (`--primary: var(--ink)`, `--on-primary: var(--bg)`), and red is reserved for alarms.
Ghost "8" segments behind live numerals; power-on self-test on every launch (about 1.1 s, skipped under reduced motion).
Seven themes re-tint the casing, keys and well without changing the structure; Light and Dark are pure neutral greys.

rules.name: The One Inverted Key Rule
rules.body: Each view has at most one ink-faced primary key (FAB on phone, "new" key in the desktop sidebar, the big calculator key, or the sheet's full-width primary key). Elsewhere, ink shows state only as an LED dot, caret, focus ring or selection.

rules.name: The No Brand Hue Rule
rules.body: The system has no accent colour. Never add one (yellow, ochre, blue or otherwise) to keys, LEDs, wells or charts. Hierarchy comes from ink inversion, weight and recess.

rules.name: The Alarm Rule
rules.body: Red means time pressure or loss: overdue, now, over capacity, delete, error. Never use it for emphasis, decoration, or mode identity.

rules.name: The Theme Contract Rule
rules.body: New surfaces may only use the shared theme tokens. Never hard-code a hex in a component, so all seven themes keep working.

rules.name: The Numerals Are Mono Rule
rules.body: Every number a user reads (time, count, date, task number, duration) is set in JetBrains Mono with tabular figures. Sentences never are.

rules.name: The Legend Is Printed Rule
rules.body: Uppercase letter-spaced mono is a legend printed on the casing or a key. It names the thing under or beside it, and it is never a headline or a decorative kicker.

rules.name: The Three Planes Rule
rules.body: Every element is casing, key, or well. If it is pressable it is a key, and if it shows a reading it is a well. Nothing sits on an in-between "card" plane.

dos: Do put every reading inside a display well and render its numerals through the Digits component, so they get ghost segments and the power-on test.
Do make every pressable control a key: raised shadow at rest, a 1px sink on press with the cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1) ease over 90ms.
Do keep one ink-faced primary key per view and show state with ink LED dots (5-9px) rather than fills.
Do separate data series by value, segment and recess (well ink vs well dim vs ghost) before reaching for a hue.
Do set every number in JetBrains Mono with tabular figures and every sentence in Golos Text.
Do define new colours as theme tokens in all seven themes, and check Paper, where the well is dark on a light body.
Do keep entry motion at about one second and reduce it to nothing under prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't introduce a brand or accent hue (yellow, ochre, blue) on keys, LEDs, wells, focus rings or charts.
Don't introduce soft floating cards, glassmorphism, or ambient-shadow tiles. Readings are recessed, not lifted.
Don't use green-on-black, scanlines, glow, or a terminal prompt aesthetic. This is a calculator, not a console.
Don't use red for emphasis, branding, decoration, or to mark a mode. It means overdue, now, over capacity, delete, or error.
Don't let user list/counter colours go beyond small markers and calendar event tints.
Don't use uppercase mono for headlines, section intros, or kickers. Legends name a control or reading and nothing else.
Don't use pill shapes or circular buttons. Circles are reserved for LEDs.
Don't hard-code hex values in components. They break the theme contract.
